about: The page tree's fluidity budgets (fluid-06): the sidebar's Docs section on a computer and the Pages sheet on a phone, over workspace.mjs's tree of 2,281 pages (40 at the top; 120, 60 and 300 under the three big ones; 24 shared, 30 private). surfaces.mjs --only pages on a production build against the fake server side, a computer at 1x and a phone at 4x (FLUIDITY-LEAD-3, 21 Oct 2026).

measured is the median of 5 quiet P-core rounds on beta 354028322 (21 Oct 2026, load 0.1-0.9); the busy diagnostic run that first set them read the same render counts but for Show more and the cached re-open, so renders are set from the quiet rounds. Times are printed against their max (enforce false); renders are enforced at the measure plus 5%. In-app presses go the way a person goes: the pointer rests 150 ms on a row (what the tree prefetches a doc on) and clicks; a phone taps.
Owners: B5 is the docs programme's page tree and Pages sheet, A3 the shared TreeView, A2 a doc's open (DOCS-LEAD-2). Never raise a max to make a run pass.

pageTreeColdMs.source: A new tab to Home, until the sidebar's Docs section draws the tree's first row. Beta 354028322 on fixtures, 21 Oct 2026, P-cores, median of 5 quiet rounds (load 0.1-0.9): 875 at 1x on a computer. Target: A new tab, nothing in memory: 1.0 s on a computer (chat programme Wave C; Nielsen's 1 s)

Target: Instant: an overlay opened within 300 ms on the 4x phone (fluid-16's rule for sheets)

treeExpandMs.source: The Handbook opened by its chevron (the pointer rests on its row first on a computer; a tap on a phone), until its first child shows. Its children are read on the press. Beta 354028322 on fixtures, 21 Oct 2026, P-cores, median of 5 quiet rounds (load 0.1-0.9): 179 at 1x on a computer; 211 at 4x on a phone. Target: Instant: a reveal in place or a switch from cache within 100 ms on a computer and 300 ms on the 4x phone (the brief; Nielsen's 0.1 s; RAIL's 100 ms response). The rival is Notion's sidebar, which opens a page's children without a wait: met only if a level is read ahead (on the pointer's rest, as a row already prefetches its doc)
